component: Marionette system-integration test timing and diagnostics

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original test inspects chrome_window_handles immediately after setup. The accepted later test first waits until at least two handles exist, then still asserts exactly two and assumes the second handle is the integration dialog. The URL assertion has no expected-behavior message. Keep the later wait separate from the original test and preserve the already-default-client limitation; no test or native startup ran.
title: The system-integration startup test later waits for its window handles
